component.name: Astralis
component.summary: Private notes with a built-in AI that runs on your own computer

description.p: Astralis is a local-first notes app: notes, whiteboards, tasks and a calendar in vaults you can encrypt, with an AI that runs entirely on your computer.

ul.li: Ask Astralis: an honest AI that critiques ideas, judges whether they'll pay off, and plans and writes notes
The Brain: project memory for AI coding agents, so they spend fewer tokens
Peer-to-peer sync, live editing and shared vaults, plus end-to-end encrypted Google Drive
A 3D graph where every vault is a galaxy and linked notes form solar systems
